acceptance_predicates.description: A bounded Git and SQLite rollback effect is reachable only after verified backup and recovery evidence.
A fresh state checkout executes the supported previous-to-new upgrade path for Git and SQLite.
Injected failures at every supported step leave a verified functional old or new runtime.
The campaign and release evidence are bound to one exact reviewed merge head.

definition_of_done: Rollback, process-death, competing-owner, stale-identity, and restore-equivalence evidence passes for both backends.
Independent review, hosted checks, post-merge verification, and state reconciliation pass.
No source-to-model refinement proof or authorization prerequisite is required.

outputs.description: Fresh-state Git/SQLite upgrade and recovery campaign.
Evidence sufficient to close AR-0009 and AR-0031.

gates.description: Old or new runtime remains verified functional after every supported injected failure.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head.
Evidence comes from a fresh isolated state checkout.
